DivKit dependency on Datastore cause binary compatibility issues with firebase
items.description:
I've tried updating Firebase BOM to version ≥ 34.0.0 and got this exception:
java.lang.ClassNotFoundException: androidx.datastore.datastore.preferences.anchor.R

After checking the dependencies, I found that only Firebase and DivKit use Datastore in my entire dependency tree. This means I'm currently blocked by DivKit from upgrading the Firebase version.

Could you please update the Datastore dependency in your project?
For reference, Firebase now uses Datastore 1.1.7.

items.title: tvOS Platform Support for DivKit
items.description:
Hello DivKit Team,

While integrating DivKitExtensions (31.13.0) into a tvOS project, we encountered the following error during validation:

- ERROR | [tvOS] unknown: Encountered an unknown error (The platform of the target `App` (tvOS 15.0) is not compatible with `DivKitExtensions (31.13.0)`, which does not support `tvOS`.)


This indicates that the current version of DivKitExtensions does not support tvOS.

Could you please clarify if there are any plans for tvOS support in future releases, or if there are any recommended workarounds for using DivKit on tvOS?

items.title: pydivkit: data field in DivCollectionItemBuilder doesn't support Expr
items.description:
Hi folks, 

I was trying to use `item_builder` with the data coming from the array variable, but looks like the pydivkit doesn't support the Expr as a valid type for the `data` field.
Here is the listing from the `div_collection_item_builder.py` (v32.6.0)
```
class DivCollectionItemBuilder(BaseDiv):

    def __init__(
        self, *,
        data: typing.Optional[typing.Sequence[typing.Any]] = None,
        data_element_name: typing.Optional[typing.Union[Expr, str]] = None,
        prototypes: typing.Optional[typing.Sequence[DivCollectionItemBuilderPrototype]] = None,
        **kwargs: typing.Any,
    ):
        super().__init__(
            data=data,
            data_element_name=data_element_name,
            prototypes=prototypes,
            **kwargs,
        )

    data: typing.Sequence[typing.Any] = Field(
        description="Data that will be used to create collection elements.",
    )
    data_element_name: typing.Optional[typing.Union[Expr, str]] = Field(
        description=(
            "Name for accessing the next `data` element in the "
            "prototype. Working with thiselement is the same as with "
            "dictionaries."
        ),
    )
    prototypes: typing.Sequence[DivCollectionItemBuilderPrototype] = Field(
        min_items=1, 
        description=(
            "Array of `div` elements from which the collection elements "
            "will be created."
        ),
    )
```

Even though the JSON like 
```
 "type": "container",
     "item_builder": {
      "data": "@{items}",
      "prototypes": [
       {
        "div": {
         "type": "container",
    ....
```
works well in the web playground. An example in the docs mentions the variable as a valid data source too: https://divkit.tech/docs/en/concepts/item_builder#dynamic-dataset

I expected the following to be a valid python code:
```
dk.DivContainer(
    orientation=dk.DivContainerOrientation.HORIZONTAL,
    item_builder=dk.DivCollectionItemBuilder(
        data=dk.core.Expr("@{items}"),
        prototypes=[
            dk.DivCollectionItemBuilderPrototype(
                div=dk.DivContainer(
                    height=dk.DivFixedSize(value=12),
                    width=dk.DivMatchParentSize(weight=1),
                    border=dk.DivBorder(corner_radius=16),
                    background=[dk.DivSolidBackground(color="#FF00FF")]
                )
            )
        ]
    )
)
```

items.title: Flutter (IOS) error: Break on 'ImpellerValidationBreak' to inspect point of failure
items.description:
**In some cases, when json is long, we have a error on IOS devices and simulator:**
```
[ERROR:flutter/impeller/base/validation.cc(59)] Break on 'ImpellerValidationBreak' to inspect point of failure: Requested texture size (1290, 16530) exceeds maximum supported size of (16384, 16384)
[ERROR:flutter/impeller/base/validation.cc(59)] Break on 'ImpellerValidationBreak' to inspect point of failure: Could not create multisample color texture.
[ERROR:flutter/impeller/base/validation.cc(59)] Break on 'ImpellerValidationBreak' to inspect point of failure: Render target does not have color attachment at index 0.
[ERROR:flutter/impeller/base/validation.cc(59)] Break on 'ImpellerValidationBreak' to inspect point of failure: Render target does not have color attachment at index 0.
[ERROR:flutter/impeller/base/validation.cc(59)] Break on 'ImpellerValidationBreak' to inspect point of failure: Subpass render target is invalid.
```

Flutter version: 3.24, 3.22

When I remove part of json, error is gone.

On Android devices and emulator work fine.

items.title: Make some suggestions
items.description: Data-driven views have always shone in the web space, like low code, no code, etc. What's different about divkit is that it's not just for web, but also for android and iOs, which is cool. Speaking from experience in the web domain, the focus of data-driven views is in three directions. 1. specification of data protocols 2. building the material ecology 3. NCLC platform **When combined with no code, it greatly extends the application area and speeds up view generation.** Can be a reference.
